nodes.plm_caption: This video features a recipe for a pie being made. The recipe makes two pies but only one is shown being made. A slice of the finished pie is shown on a red napkin at the beginning of the video and there is a flash that shows different components of the pie throughout the video. There is also a shot of someone mixing ingredients in a large pot and preparing the dough to form the pie and then baking the finished product.

summary.brief: A fruit custard pie is made by preparing a custard‑fruit filling, baking a butter crust, and assembling the layers.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a blue title slide saying “How to make Pai – Fruit Custard Pie,” followed by a quick flash of a slice of the finished pie on a red napkin. A brief montage shows the individual ingredients. In a large pot the cook mixes custard powder, sugar and milk, stirring until the mixture thickens over medium heat. Canned fruit such as crushed pineapple, sliced mango or fruit cocktail is folded into the hot custard, which is cooked a little longer and then set aside to cool. Meanwhile, softened room‑temperature butter is combined with flour, sugar, an egg, baking powder and a splash of vanilla; the mixture is mixed until a crumbly dough forms. The dough is pressed into a greased or lined baking pan, the edges are crimped, and the crust is baked until golden brown and cooled. Once the crust is cool, the chilled custard‑fruit filling is poured into it and spread evenly. The pie may be topped with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkled with chopped nuts, and the completed dessert is displayed.

action.detailed: Mix custard powder, sugar and milk in a pot, heat until thick, fold in canned fruit and let the filling cool; combine butter, flour, sugar, egg, baking powder and vanilla into a crumbly dough, press into a greased pan and bake until golden; pour the cooled custard‑fruit filling into the baked crust, spread evenly, and top with whipped cream and chopped nuts if desired.

summary.brief: The video demonstrates how to make a fruit custard pie by preparing a custard‑fruit filling, baking a simple butter crust, and topping the assembled tart with whipped cream and nuts.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a teal title slide that reads “How to make Pai – Fruit Custard Pie.” A pot is used to combine custard powder, sugar and a small amount of milk into a smooth paste, then the rest of the milk is added and the mixture is heated on medium heat until it thickens into a pink‑white custard. Chopped canned fruit such as pineapple, mango or fruit cocktail is stirred in, the custard is cooked a little longer and then set aside to cool. In a separate bowl, room‑temperature butter is mixed with flour, sugar, an egg, baking powder and a splash of vanilla until a crumbly dough forms; the hands (some wearing silver jewelry) press the dough into a greased or parchment‑lined baking pan and crimp the edges, then the crust is baked until golden brown. After the crust cools, the cooled fruit custard is poured into it and spread evenly. Whipped cream is dolloped over the filling, spread across the surface, and sprinkled with chopped nuts or sliced peaches. An optional step shows beating egg whites with sugar into a fluffy meringue, spreading it over a warm filling, and baking briefly to set. The finished tart is presented on the turquoise backdrop while the camera tilts upward, partially cutting off a large logo.

action.detailed: Mix custard powder, sugar and milk in a pot, heat until thick, stir in canned fruit and cool; combine butter, flour, sugar, egg, baking powder and vanilla into a dough, press into a pan and bake until golden; pour the cooled custard into the baked crust, spread it, then add and spread whipped cream, sprinkle nuts, and optionally top with meringue before a final brief bake.
